hushgram.title: v0.0.16
hushgram.body:
The accent color can follow your wallpaper now with Material You on Android 12 and newer, and the red badges can take your color too. You can add your own story fonts, pick a different app icon and hide the rows you never use in Instagram's settings. Messages can go full screen, tall reels can fill the screen, and a left swipe on a reel opens the profile. A new lock keeps HushGram's settings from changing for up to 72 hours. The glass tab bar and the like animations got a round of fixes too.

New in this release

- `Accent color`: `Material You` is a new choice in the `Color` list on Android 12 and newer. Buttons, links and highlights take your wallpaper's colors, in light and dark mode, after a restart. Asked for in #187 and #264.

- `Accent color`: New `Badges in the accent color` switch under it, off to start. The red dots and counts for new messages and notifications take the color you picked, after a restart. Asked for in #315.

- `Story text fonts`: new patch, off to start. Add .ttf or .otf files under `Your story fonts` in Stories, and they show up by file name in the story text editor after Instagram's own fonts. Asked for in #275.

- `Story text fonts`: New `Emoji font in story text` switch under Stories, off to start. Turning it on asks for an emoji font file (.ttf), and the emoji you type in story text draw in it. Asked for in #275.

- `Pick the app icon`: new patch. `App icon` under Layout swaps the home screen icon for HushGram's, or Instagram's glyph on black or plum. It changes once you leave Instagram. Starts on Instagram's own. Asked for in #284.

- `Hide rows in Instagram's settings`: new patch. Open Instagram's Settings and activity once, then untick the rows you never use under `Rows in Instagram's settings` in Layout and they're gone from that screen. Every row shows to start. Asked for in #235 and #250.

- `Full screen Reels and Home`: New `Full screen Messages` switch under Messages. Your messages and open chats hide the bars picked in `Bars to hide`, and a swipe in from the edge brings them back for a moment. Typing and Back work as usual. Asked for in #288.

- `Full screen Reels and Home`: New `Fill the screen` switch under Full screen Reels, off to start. Tall reels that showed black bars above and below fill the screen instead, trimmed a little at the sides. Square and wide videos still fit. Reported in #288.

- `Save profile picture`: New `Profile extras button` switch, off to start. It puts a small button next to the three dots on a profile that opens the profile actions you turned on. The three-dot menu keeps its rows. Asked for in #234.

- `Change the like animation`: The `Like animation` list now shows a heart under it and plays each one as you tap it. OK saves the one you like, and Cancel keeps the old one. Asked for in #299.

- `Stop Reels scrolling`: New `Take a scroll break` list under Reels, off to start. After 10 to 60 minutes on Home, Reels and Explore, a break screen covers them for 5 minutes. Messages, your profile and the tab bar still work. Asked for in #297.

- `HushGram settings`: New `Lock these settings` row under Pause HushGram. Pick a 1 to 72 hour wait and every setting greys out, Pause included. `Ask to unlock` starts the wait (a tap stops it), then the page opens for 10 minutes. Asked for in #301.

- `HushGram settings`: A small dot now marks settings added since you last looked, and the category row that holds them. It clears once you've been through that page. A fresh install shows none. Asked for in #274.

- `Clean up Reels`: New `Hide the Friends tab on Reels` switch under Reels, off to start. It takes the Friends tab off the top of the Reels tab, and Reels moves over to fill the space. No restart needed. Asked for in #300.

- `Hide the Reels tab`: New `Logo and titles at the start` switch under Tab bar, for accounts where Instagram moved the Home logo and bar titles to the middle. It puts them back at the start. Asked for in #310.

- `Hide the Reels tab`: New `Hide the Messages tab` switch under Tab bar takes the Messages button off the tab bar, no restart needed. If Home's header has no Messages button, HushGram adds one so your chats stay a tap away. Asked for in #298 and #307.

- `Hide suggested posts`: New `Hide the caught up card` switch under Feed, off to start. It folds the "You've seen the latest posts" card, so Home runs straight on into the rest of the feed. With no new posts, the card stays. Reported in #307.

- `Download any video`: Details has a Copy caption without hashtags row for captions that have them. It drops a closing block of tags and the dots above it, and a tag inside a sentence keeps its word. Reported in #282.

- `Swipe left to open the profile`: new patch, off to start. Turned on under Reels, a left swipe on a reel slides in the creator's profile, like Instagram used to. A right swipe or Back on that profile returns to the reel. Takes a restart. Asked for in #245 and #283.

- `Full resolution photos`: New `Full size covers` switch under Feed. Reel covers and grid pictures load at full size, so Download cover saves 1080 pixels wide, not 240 to 480. It uses a lot more data, so it starts off. Takes a restart. Asked for in #214.

- `Glass tab bar`: With `Liquid glass look` on, the active tab sits in a raised glass bubble that swells while it moves and bends what's behind it on Android 13 and up. New `Blur strength` row sets how much the pill blurs. Asked for in #289.

- `Hide profile tabs`: `Tabs on profiles` is now two rows, `Tabs on your profile` and `Tabs on other profiles`, so Reels can go from yours and stay on everyone else's. Your old pick covers both until you change one. Asked for in #296.

Fixes

- `Glass tab bar`: The outline Instagram draws round the message count and the dots on the tab bar is clear now, so it doesn't sit on the glass as a solid ring. The dot grows a little into the space the outline took. Reported in #315.

- `Hide suggested posts`: `Hide 'Are you interested?' bubbles` takes the question off Reels too, the Not interested and Interested row under a reel. Before, only Home's bubble went. (#131)

- `Glass tab bar`: With `Full screen Reels` on, the floating pill dropped by the navigation bar's height every time you switched to Reels, then jumped back up on the other tabs. It stays at one height on every tab now. Reported in #285.

- `Glass tab bar`: A video playing under the glass pill no longer turns the pill black. Some videos play on a layer the blur couldn't see, so it blurs a small copy of the video's picture now. Reported in #144.

- `Change the like animation`: The animation you picked plays on Instagram 452's feed and Reels hearts again, for a double tap and for the heart button. 452 had been showing its usual heart there. Reported in #299.

- `View stories anonymously`: With `Gray out stories you've watched` on, stories you've watched now move behind the new ones in the story row at the top of Home too. Before, only the stories inside the feed were reordered. (#241)

- `Read messages without the seen receipt`: With `Keep chats unread here` off, a chat you opened could still flip back to unread after a refresh. Now it stays read until a new message comes in. (#186)

- `Download any reel`: The Details row in a reel's menu shows Instagram's info icon now. It used to wear Download's arrow. (#282)

- `Download any reel`: A photo post opened on the Reels tab or from a hashtag page gets Details in its menu too, under Download. Until now only videos and photos with music had it. (#282)

- `Start Home on Following`: With `Only accounts you follow` on, Back to home at the end of your Following feed takes you back up to the newest post. Before, the link did nothing.

- `HushGram settings`: Opening an Instagram link or a notification while HushGram settings are up closes them, so you land where it leads. A link that arrives while they're still opening wins too. The tab used to change behind them.

- `Clean up Reels`: With `Keep clear mode on`, starting a swipe back and letting the reel snap back into place could end clear mode on that reel and bring its buttons back. It stays in clear mode now. Reported in #233.

- `HushGram settings`: With a HushGram PIN set, importing a settings file no longer calls `Lock your messages` and `Lock all of Instagram` unknown settings. Those switches stay as they are until you change them on the settings page.

- `Download any video`: The Details row in a feed post's menu shows Instagram's info icon now, not Download's arrow.

- `Hide suggested people on profiles`: `Hide Suggested for you on follow lists` now also takes the Suggested tab off other people's follow lists, and the Suggested for you block under their mutual followers. Before, it only reached the bottom of the followers and following lists. Reported in #302.

- `Blur the bars around Reels`: The band behind the clock and the gesture bar's strip stayed black on Reels. Both show the reel blurred now, a little darker behind the clock under white icons so the time stays easy to read. Reported in #258.

- `Sanitize sharing links`: Share and Copy link in Instagram's in-app browser move an Instagram page's link to your Sharing domain now, as the share sheet and Copy link on a post already did. Those two had still said instagram.com. Thanks to @Aholicknight for the fix in #304.

- `Find the reel you came from`: A trial reel from someone else isn't on their profile, so the search used to keep scrolling and then give up. Once the grid has gone past the reel's date it stops and says the reel isn't there. Reported in #225.

Other changes

- With `Send downloads to another app` on, the first download after each start shows a short note saying this switch opened the share sheet and where to turn it off. It looked just like Instagram's own Share. Reported in #305.

- `Upload stories at full quality`: The switch's description now says what you actually get. Video stories still go up at 1080p, but Instagram shrinks every story video to 720p on its servers, so viewers see only a small difference. (#37)

Behind the scenes

- HushGram builds on Gradle 9.8.2 now, with androidx.annotation 1.11.0 and commons-lang3 3.21.0. Each new download was checked against its publisher's checksums before it went on the verification list. The patches themselves don't change.

- The HushGram settings code is split into one file per category, so a row is easier to find. Every category lists the same rows in the same order, and search finds the same ones.

The [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) has every earlier release too.

How to update

1. Update Morphe Manager to 2.0.0 or newer, then refresh the HushGram source.
2. Patch Instagram `452.1.0.53.64`. [Supported Instagram builds](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram#supported-instagram-builds) lists the builds that work.
3. Install over your current patched Instagram with the manager's existing signing key. Keep that key so updates keep working.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not an Instagram APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram#install).

What was checked

6335 runtime tests passed locally. All 2129 patch tests passed too.

All four Instagram 452.1.0.53.64 builds took 116 of the 117 patches, everything but Install next to Instagram, which makes a second app. I patched Instagram with this exact bundle and walked the whole app on an emulator, then opened the feed, Explore, Reels, the inbox and a profile from a fresh start, and Instagram didn't crash once.

- `Clean up Reels`: New `Hide the Friends tab on Reels` switch under Reels, off to start. It takes the Friends tab off the top of the Reels tab, and Reels moves over to fill the space. No restart needed. Asked for in #300.

- `Download any video`: Details has a Copy caption without hashtags row for captions that have them. It drops a closing block of tags and the dots above it, and a tag inside a sentence keeps its word. Reported in #282.

- `Swipe left to open the profile`: new patch, off to start. Turned on under Reels, a left swipe on a reel slides in the creator's profile, like Instagram used to. A right swipe or Back on that profile returns to the reel. Takes a restart. Asked for in #245 and #283.

Fixes

- `Glass tab bar`: The outline Instagram draws round the message count and the dots on the tab bar is clear now, so it doesn't sit on the glass as a solid ring. The dot grows a little into the space the outline took. Reported in #315.

- `Hide suggested posts`: `Hide 'Are you interested?' bubbles` takes the question off Reels too, the Not interested and Interested row under a reel. Before, only Home's bubble went. (#131)

- `Glass tab bar`: With `Full screen Reels` on, the floating pill dropped by the navigation bar's height every time you switched to Reels, then jumped back up on the other tabs. It stays at one height on every tab now. Reported in #285.

- `Glass tab bar`: A video playing under the glass pill no longer turns the pill black. Some videos play on a layer the blur couldn't see, so it blurs a small copy of the video's picture now. Reported in #144.

- `Change the like animation`: The animation you picked plays on Instagram 452's feed and Reels hearts again, for a double tap and for the heart button. 452 had been showing its usual heart there. Reported in #299.

- `View stories anonymously`: With `Gray out stories you've watched` on, stories you've watched now move behind the new ones in the story row at the top of Home too. Before, only the stories inside the feed were reordered. (#241)

- `Read messages without the seen receipt`: With `Keep chats unread here` off, a chat you opened could still flip back to unread after a refresh. Now it stays read until a new message comes in. (#186)

- `Download any reel`: The Details row in a reel's menu shows Instagram's info icon now. It used to wear Download's arrow. (#282)

- `Download any reel`: A photo post opened on the Reels tab or from a hashtag page gets Details in its menu too, under Download. Until now only videos and photos with music had it. (#282)

- `Start Home on Following`: With `Only accounts you follow` on, Back to home at the end of your Following feed takes you back up to the newest post. Before, the link did nothing.

- `HushGram settings`: Opening an Instagram link or a notification while HushGram settings are up closes them, so you land where it leads. A link that arrives while they're still opening wins too. The tab used to change behind them.

- `Clean up Reels`: With `Keep clear mode on`, starting a swipe back and letting the reel snap back into place could end clear mode on that reel and bring its buttons back. It stays in clear mode now. Reported in #233.

- `HushGram settings`: With a HushGram PIN set, importing a settings file no longer calls `Lock your messages` and `Lock all of Instagram` unknown settings. Those switches stay as they are until you change them on the settings page.

- `Download any video`: The Details row in a feed post's menu shows Instagram's info icon now, not Download's arrow.

- `Hide suggested people on profiles`: `Hide Suggested for you on follow lists` now also takes the Suggested tab off other people's follow lists, and the Suggested for you block under their mutual followers. Before, it only reached the bottom of the followers and following lists. Reported in #302.

- `Blur the bars around Reels`: The band behind the clock and the gesture bar's strip stayed black on Reels. Both show the reel blurred now, a little darker behind the clock under white icons so the time stays easy to read. Reported in #258.

- `Sanitize sharing links`: Share and Copy link in Instagram's in-app browser move an Instagram page's link to your Sharing domain now, as the share sheet and Copy link on a post already did. Those two had still said instagram.com. Thanks to @Aholicknight for the fix in #304.

- `Find the reel you came from`: A trial reel from someone else isn't on their profile, so the search used to keep scrolling and then give up. Once the grid has gone past the reel's date it stops and says the reel isn't there. Reported in #225.

Other changes

- With `Send downloads to another app` on, the first download after each start shows a short note saying this switch opened the share sheet and where to turn it off. It looked just like Instagram's own Share. Reported in #305.

- `Upload stories at full quality`: The switch's description now says what you actually get. Video stories still go up at 1080p, but Instagram shrinks every story video to 720p on its servers, so viewers see only a small difference. (#37)

Behind the scenes

- HushGram builds on Gradle 9.8.2 now, with androidx.annotation 1.11.0 and commons-lang3 3.21.0. Each new download was checked against its publisher's checksums before it went on the verification list. The patches themselves don't change.

- The HushGram settings code is split into one file per category, so a row is easier to find. Every category lists the same rows in the same order, and search finds the same ones.

The [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) has every earlier release too.

How to update

1. Update Morphe Manager to 2.0.0 or newer, then refresh the HushGram source.
2. Patch Instagram `452.1.0.53.64`. [Supported Instagram builds](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram#supported-instagram-builds) lists the builds that work.
3. Install over your current patched Instagram with the manager's existing signing key. Keep that key so updates keep working.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not an Instagram APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram#install).

What was checked

6335 runtime tests passed locally. All 2129 patch tests passed too.

All four Instagram 452.1.0.53.64 builds took 116 of the 117 patches, everything but Install next to Instagram, which makes a second app. I patched Instagram with this exact bundle and walked the whole app on an emulator, then opened the feed, Explore, Reels, the inbox and a profile from a fresh start, and Instagram didn't crash once.

hushpinterest.title: v0.0.13
hushpinterest.body:
HushPinterest 0.0.13 has 33 patches for Pinterest 14.41.0. It's the first one built on Morphe patcher 2.0.0, so update Morphe Manager to 2.0.0 or newer before you patch. Older Manager builds can't open this bundle.

The new patch is GmsCore support, for phones that run microG-RE instead of Google Play services. It sends Pinterest's Google sign-in and push notifications through microG-RE. It isn't picked by default, so if you don't use microG-RE nothing changes for you.

Patch 14.41.0 with the same signing key you used before and install it over your current HushPinterest. Your settings stay as they are.

## What's new

- New GmsCore support patch, for phones that run microG-RE instead of Google Play services. Pinterest's Google sign-in and push notifications go through microG-RE, so Continue with Google opens microG-RE's sign-in. Before, it asked Play services and the account got turned down. It's left out of the default selection since without microG-RE those requests have nowhere to go. Pick it in Expert mode and Spoof signature for Google sign-in comes along with it. (#15)
- The patches are now built on Morphe patcher 2.0.0, so you'll need Morphe Manager 2.0.0 or newer to apply them. Older Manager builds can't load the bundle.

## Behind the scenes

- A release can't go public until the whole app has been walked with that exact bundle on a release phone or an emulator. The publish stage now takes the walk's receipt as `-Walk` and stops before GitHub or the index if the walk wasn't a full pass, saw a Pinterest crash, ran on some other device, or patched with a different bundle.
- A device lease another session happens to be reading no longer stops a run partway. The check waits a moment and tries again, and a lease that stays locked still stops it.
- New `scripts/walk-app.ps1` patches Pinterest from the release bundle and installs it on a leased phone or emulator. Then it opens the home feed, the patched screens and every Hush settings page, and writes the receipt publish asks for. Only a full walk with no Pinterest crash earns a PASS.

## Install

1. Install [Morphe Manager](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager) 2.0.0 or newer.
2. Add HushPinterest as a patch source: https://morphe.software/add-source?github=SysAdminDoc%2FHushPinterest
3. Download Pinterest 14.41.0, version code `14418010`. APKMirror has it as an arm64-v8a bundle (`.apkm`) for Android 12L or newer. Pick that file in Manager and it merges the parts before patching.
4. Uninstall the stock Pinterest first, since Android won't put one over the other. Save anything you keep only on the phone before you do. Your boards and pins come back when you sign in.
5. Sign in with your email and a Pinterest password. If you joined through Google or Facebook, tap `Forgot your password?` on Pinterest's login page to set one first. On a phone with microG-RE, pick GmsCore support when you patch and Continue with Google goes to microG-RE's sign-in instead.
6. Right after your first patch, export Morphe Manager's signing key (Settings, then System, then Import & export, then Signing key) and keep it somewhere private. Updates only install over a Pinterest signed with that same key.

Already on HushPinterest? Update Manager, then skip steps 4 and 5. Patch 14.41.0 with the same key and install it over the one you have.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Pinterest APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushPinterest#install). `SHA256SUMS.txt` is signed with the HushPinterest release key, fingerprint `FCE5 ECE3 182A 647B 3AF2  C5ED 2DC3 5E8D 5C00 E8A6`. [How to check a download](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushPinterest#verify-a-release-download).

## Reported issues

- #15: GmsCore support is new in this release, for signing in with Google on a phone that has microG-RE instead of Play services.

## Validation

All 241 patch tests and 1069 extension tests passed on this commit, none skipped. The bundle attached here was patched onto a real Pinterest 14.41.0 bundle from APKMirror with Morphe's desktop patcher, and all 33 patches applied without forcing. `release-receipt-0.0.13.json` records that result, the bundle's hash and what patching changed in the app's manifest.

Before release, this exact bundle patched a Pinterest that went on an Android emulator for a walk through the whole app: the home feed, a pin, notifications, searches for pins, boards and people, and all ten HushPinterest settings pages. Pinterest didn't crash once.

GmsCore support was tried on an emulator with microG-RE installed. Pinterest opened microG-RE's Google sign-in at launch, and Continue with Google went on to microG-RE's account screen. That emulator had no Google account added, so a full sign-in wasn't done there.

hushtelegram.title: v0.0.20
hushtelegram.body:
HushTelegram v0.0.20 has 67 patches for Telegram 13.1.0, on both telegram.org's build (`org.telegram.messenger.web`, version code 72299) and the Google Play build (`org.telegram.messenger`, version code 72291). It's built on Morphe's 2.0 patcher now, so update Morphe Manager to 2.0.0 or newer before you patch. Sixty-three patches are selected by default, and every new switch starts off. Four of those new switches came from your reports: a red label on kept deleted messages, hiding the new message button, full screen videos that turn to either side, and saving files from chats that don't allow saving. A settings lock you didn't mean can be undone for 10 minutes now, and the settings home page takes less scrolling. If Telegram won't send a login code and shows `API_ID_PUBLISHED_FLOOD`, step 5 under Install fixes it.

## What's new

* **Telegram:** Moved to Telegram 13.1.0, both telegram.org's build (version code 72299) and the Google Play build (version code 72291). Every patch carried over as it was.
* **Telegram:** HushTelegram now builds on Morphe's 2.0 patcher, so this release needs **Morphe Manager 2.0.0 or newer**. Update Manager first, then patch. On a computer, use morphe-desktop 1.19.0 or newer. The patch count is the same, and every patch still applies to both 13.1.0 builds.
* **Telegram:** The HushTelegram settings home page gets you to the settings sooner. The seven pages of switches now sit right under the status card, and the header, the gaps between cards, the section titles and the page rows all take less room. **Quick setups** moved to the Settings backup page and **Lock HushTelegram settings** to the Pause page under More settings. Search finds both, and they work like before. The long press that hid Quick setups is gone, and so is its **Quick setups on the home page** row.
* **Telegram:** Locking the HushTelegram settings by mistake no longer costs you a day. For 10 minutes after you lock them, the row reads **Unlock now** and one tap opens them again. After that, unlocking takes the usual 24 hours. Changing the phone's clock or restarting the phone ends those 10 minutes early. (#23)
* **Telegram:** Save downloaded files has a new switch under it, **Also save from chats that don't allow saving**, and it starts off. With it on, files and songs from chats whose owner turned off saving get a copy in Download/Telegram too. That's for chats where the owner doesn't mind you keeping things. Secret chats and self-destructing media still stay inside Telegram. (#29)
* **Telegram:** Save downloaded files now covers the files and songs Telegram downloads on its own, too. Before, a file that auto-download fetched while its chat was closed stayed in Telegram even with the switch on, and only files downloaded in an open chat got a copy. Those now go to Download/Telegram under their own names, and chats that don't allow saving follow the same switch as everything else. (#29)
* **Telegram:** Keep deleted messages gets a second switch, **Show deleted in red**. Off by default. Turn it on and the word "deleted" next to a kept message's time turns red, so those messages stand out while you scroll. The time keeps its usual color and the bubble stays the same size. (#25)
* **Telegram:** **Hide Contacts tab** has one more switch on the Chat list page, **Hide new message button**. It hides the round pencil button on the chat list. The story camera button, the archive, your folders and search all work as before, and you start a new chat from the menu or from search instead. It's off until you turn it on, and the change shows after a restart. (#22)
* **Telegram:** **Keep videos muted on volume keys** has a second switch on the Playback page, **Full screen videos turn either way**. Telegram puts a full screen video on one landscape side and leaves it there, so turning the phone the other way shows the picture upside down. With this switch on, the video follows your phone to either side, even with auto-rotate off. It starts off. (#27)

### Tooling

* **Tooling:** A release can't go public until the whole app has been walked with that exact bundle on a release phone or an emulator. The publish stage now takes the walk's receipt as `-Walk`, and it stops before the notes, the tag or GitHub if the walk wasn't a full pass, saw a Telegram crash, ran on some other device, or patched with a different bundle. `scripts/walk-app.ps1` runs the walk. It patches Telegram from the bundle and installs it on a leased phone or emulator without touching the app's data, then opens Telegram's own screens and every HushTelegram settings page and reads the crash log. `patch-for-device.ps1 -CliDefaultKeystore` signs with a keystore the desktop CLI made.
* **Tooling:** The release and patch selection scripts read morphe-desktop 1.19.0's results as well as 1.18.1's. The new CLI renamed its list of patching steps, lists applied patches without the rest of their details, and writes a failed patch as just its name and error. It also skips the result file when it can't read the options file. A result with no steps, or with a failed step, is still refused.

## Install

1. Install [Morphe Manager](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager) 2.0.0 or newer. This release needs 2.0.0, so update Manager before you patch.
2. Add HushTelegram as a patch source: https://morphe.software/add-source?github=SysAdminDoc%2FHushTelegram
3. Get Telegram 13.1.0. Two builds work: telegram.org's [Download button](https://telegram.org/android) (`org.telegram.messenger.web`, version code 72299) and the Google Play build (`org.telegram.messenger`, version code 72291), the one most people already have, which [APKMirror](https://www.apkmirror.com/apk/telegram-fz-llc/telegram/) and Uptodown also carry. The patched app needs Android 9 or newer.
4. Coming from an earlier HushTelegram? Patch the 13.1.0 APK of the same build you're on and install it over your current HushTelegram with the same Morphe Manager signing key. New to HushTelegram? Uninstall the stock Telegram first, since Android won't put a patched app over one signed with a different key. Your chats come back when you sign in, but secret chats don't. Back up Morphe Manager's signing key after your first patch. You'll need it for every update.
5. If Telegram turns down your login code with `API_ID_PUBLISHED_FLOOD`, that's Telegram refusing the public API ID that ships with any patched build, the Play one included. Register your own app at [my.telegram.org/apps](https://my.telegram.org/apps), using only letters and numbers in the short name. Then select `Use registered Telegram API credentials`, fill in `apiId` and `apiHash`, and patch again. The result installs over your current HushTelegram build. Keep both values private.
6. Want HushTelegram's own icon, or Telegram's logo in white on the black launch screen? Turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager and pick `HushTelegram icon and name` or `Black and white launch logo` before you patch.
7. For notifications, open Telegram's Settings, tap Notifications, and turn on `Keep-Alive Service` and `Background Connection` under Other, near the bottom of the page. Phones where Firebase notifications don't come through can also try the `UnifiedPush notifications` switch on HushTelegram's Notifications page with a UnifiedPush app like ntfy.
8. To change HushTelegram's switches, open Telegram's Settings and tap HushTelegram settings, or press and hold the Telegram title at the top of your chat list. The side menu is the `Side menu` switch on the Chat list page.

## Validation

All 1378 runtime tests passed locally, and all 488 patch tests passed too, along with both Android lints (the shared library and the Telegram extension). Every one of the 67 patches applied to Telegram 13.1.0 without forcing, on both telegram.org's build (version code 72299) and the Google Play build (version code 72291). For each patched build the release receipt checked the package name, version, manifest, native libraries and zip alignment. telegram.org's build, patched from this exact bundle, was installed over an older HushTelegram on an Android 13 emulator without clearing its data. Then the whole HushTelegram settings screen was walked, the home page and all 15 pages under it, with no crash. That emulator isn't signed in to Telegram, so the walk ended at Telegram's sign-in screen.

repos.title: v0.0.20
repos.body:
HushTelegram v0.0.20 has 67 patches for Telegram 13.1.0, on both telegram.org's build (`org.telegram.messenger.web`, version code 72299) and the Google Play build (`org.telegram.messenger`, version code 72291). It's built on Morphe's 2.0 patcher now, so update Morphe Manager to 2.0.0 or newer before you patch. Sixty-three patches are selected by default, and every new switch starts off. Four of those new switches came from your reports: a red label on kept deleted messages, hiding the new message button, full screen videos that turn to either side, and saving files from chats that don't allow saving. A settings lock you didn't mean can be undone for 10 minutes now, and the settings home page takes less scrolling. If Telegram won't send a login code and shows `API_ID_PUBLISHED_FLOOD`, step 5 under Install fixes it.

## What's new

* **Telegram:** Moved to Telegram 13.1.0, both telegram.org's build (version code 72299) and the Google Play build (version code 72291). Every patch carried over as it was.
* **Telegram:** HushTelegram now builds on Morphe's 2.0 patcher, so this release needs **Morphe Manager 2.0.0 or newer**. Update Manager first, then patch. On a computer, use morphe-desktop 1.19.0 or newer. The patch count is the same, and every patch still applies to both 13.1.0 builds.
* **Telegram:** The HushTelegram settings home page gets you to the settings sooner. The seven pages of switches now sit right under the status card, and the header, the gaps between cards, the section titles and the page rows all take less room. **Quick setups** moved to the Settings backup page and **Lock HushTelegram settings** to the Pause page under More settings. Search finds both, and they work like before. The long press that hid Quick setups is gone, and so is its **Quick setups on the home page** row.
* **Telegram:** Locking the HushTelegram settings by mistake no longer costs you a day. For 10 minutes after you lock them, the row reads **Unlock now** and one tap opens them again. After that, unlocking takes the usual 24 hours. Changing the phone's clock or restarting the phone ends those 10 minutes early. (#23)
* **Telegram:** Save downloaded files has a new switch under it, **Also save from chats that don't allow saving**, and it starts off. With it on, files and songs from chats whose owner turned off saving get a copy in Download/Telegram too. That's for chats where the owner doesn't mind you keeping things. Secret chats and self-destructing media still stay inside Telegram. (#29)
* **Telegram:** Save downloaded files now covers the files and songs Telegram downloads on its own, too. Before, a file that auto-download fetched while its chat was closed stayed in Telegram even with the switch on, and only files downloaded in an open chat got a copy. Those now go to Download/Telegram under their own names, and chats that don't allow saving follow the same switch as everything else. (#29)
* **Telegram:** Keep deleted messages gets a second switch, **Show deleted in red**. Off by default. Turn it on and the word "deleted" next to a kept message's time turns red, so those messages stand out while you scroll. The time keeps its usual color and the bubble stays the same size. (#25)
* **Telegram:** **Hide Contacts tab** has one more switch on the Chat list page, **Hide new message button**. It hides the round pencil button on the chat list. The story camera button, the archive, your folders and search all work as before, and you start a new chat from the menu or from search instead. It's off until you turn it on, and the change shows after a restart. (#22)
* **Telegram:** **Keep videos muted on volume keys** has a second switch on the Playback page, **Full screen videos turn either way**. Telegram puts a full screen video on one landscape side and leaves it there, so turning the phone the other way shows the picture upside down. With this switch on, the video follows your phone to either side, even with auto-rotate off. It starts off. (#27)

### Tooling

* **Tooling:** A release can't go public until the whole app has been walked with that exact bundle on a release phone or an emulator. The publish stage now takes the walk's receipt as `-Walk`, and it stops before the notes, the tag or GitHub if the walk wasn't a full pass, saw a Telegram crash, ran on some other device, or patched with a different bundle. `scripts/walk-app.ps1` runs the walk. It patches Telegram from the bundle and installs it on a leased phone or emulator without touching the app's data, then opens Telegram's own screens and every HushTelegram settings page and reads the crash log. `patch-for-device.ps1 -CliDefaultKeystore` signs with a keystore the desktop CLI made.
* **Tooling:** The release and patch selection scripts read morphe-desktop 1.19.0's results as well as 1.18.1's. The new CLI renamed its list of patching steps, lists applied patches without the rest of their details, and writes a failed patch as just its name and error. It also skips the result file when it can't read the options file. A result with no steps, or with a failed step, is still refused.

## Install

1. Install [Morphe Manager](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager) 2.0.0 or newer. This release needs 2.0.0, so update Manager before you patch.
2. Add HushTelegram as a patch source: https://morphe.software/add-source?github=SysAdminDoc%2FHushTelegram
3. Get Telegram 13.1.0. Two builds work: telegram.org's [Download button](https://telegram.org/android) (`org.telegram.messenger.web`, version code 72299) and the Google Play build (`org.telegram.messenger`, version code 72291), the one most people already have, which [APKMirror](https://www.apkmirror.com/apk/telegram-fz-llc/telegram/) and Uptodown also carry. The patched app needs Android 9 or newer.
4. Coming from an earlier HushTelegram? Patch the 13.1.0 APK of the same build you're on and install it over your current HushTelegram with the same Morphe Manager signing key. New to HushTelegram? Uninstall the stock Telegram first, since Android won't put a patched app over one signed with a different key. Your chats come back when you sign in, but secret chats don't. Back up Morphe Manager's signing key after your first patch. You'll need it for every update.
5. If Telegram turns down your login code with `API_ID_PUBLISHED_FLOOD`, that's Telegram refusing the public API ID that ships with any patched build, the Play one included. Register your own app at [my.telegram.org/apps](https://my.telegram.org/apps), using only letters and numbers in the short name. Then select `Use registered Telegram API credentials`, fill in `apiId` and `apiHash`, and patch again. The result installs over your current HushTelegram build. Keep both values private.
6. Want HushTelegram's own icon, or Telegram's logo in white on the black launch screen? Turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager and pick `HushTelegram icon and name` or `Black and white launch logo` before you patch.
7. For notifications, open Telegram's Settings, tap Notifications, and turn on `Keep-Alive Service` and `Background Connection` under Other, near the bottom of the page. Phones where Firebase notifications don't come through can also try the `UnifiedPush notifications` switch on HushTelegram's Notifications page with a UnifiedPush app like ntfy.
8. To change HushTelegram's switches, open Telegram's Settings and tap HushTelegram settings, or press and hold the Telegram title at the top of your chat list. The side menu is the `Side menu` switch on the Chat list page.

## Validation

All 1378 runtime tests passed locally, and all 488 patch tests passed too, along with both Android lints (the shared library and the Telegram extension). Every one of the 67 patches applied to Telegram 13.1.0 without forcing, on both telegram.org's build (version code 72299) and the Google Play build (version code 72291). For each patched build the release receipt checked the package name, version, manifest, native libraries and zip alignment. telegram.org's build, patched from this exact bundle, was installed over an older HushTelegram on an Android 13 emulator without clearing its data. Then the whole HushTelegram settings screen was walked, the home page and all 15 pages under it, with no crash. That emulator isn't signed in to Telegram, so the walk ended at Telegram's sign-in screen.

hushthreads.body:
HushThreads v0.0.16 has 20 patches for Threads 452.0.0.50.64 (`com.instagram.barcelona`), and it patches that version only. It's built on Morphe patcher 2.0.0, so you need Morphe Manager 2.0.0 or newer. Update Threads to 452 before you patch.

Hide ads now also goes after the ads Threads fetches for the replies under an opened post. There's a new `Disable swipe to Search` patch too, for accounts where a sideways swipe on the feed slides into Search.

**Your reports in this release**

- [#12](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushThreads/issues/12) found ads among the replies when you open a post. Those come with the post rather than through the feed, and Hide ads now empties that list as well.
- [#13](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushThreads/issues/13) asked for a way to stop the feed sliding into Search on a sideways swipe. Turn on `No swipe into Search` on the Feed page and restart Threads. The Search button still works.

## Threads

- HushThreads now patches Threads 452.0.0.50.64 only, the newest stable version, and drops 451.0.0.51.80. Update Threads to 452 before you patch. The bundle is built with Morphe's 2.0 patcher, so you'll need Morphe Manager 2.0.0 or newer.
- Hide ads now also takes out the ads that show up among the replies when you open a post. Threads sends those with the post instead of through your feed, which is how they slipped past before. Turn Hide ads off, or pause HushThreads, and they show the way Threads draws them. The Hide ads switch says so in all six languages.
- New `Disable swipe to Search` patch. On accounts where a sideways swipe on your feed slides into Search, the swipe stops and your feed stays put. The Search button still opens Search. Only some accounts have the swipe, and on the others nothing changes. The `No swipe into Search` switch is on the Feed page of HushThreads settings and starts off. Restart Threads after you flip it.
- A download that runs out of its ten minutes now always says it was too slow. Every so often its last wait ended a fraction of a millisecond early, and you were told the network failed instead.

## Tooling

- A release can't go public until the whole app is walked with that exact bundle on a release phone or an emulator. The publish stage now takes the walk's receipt as `-Walk` and stops before the tag or GitHub if the walk wasn't a full pass, saw a Threads crash, ran on some other device, or patched with a different bundle.
- `scripts/walk-app.ps1` does that walk. It patches Threads from the release bundle and installs it, opens the feed, Search, Activity, a profile and a post by their links, then goes in through the Profile tab, the profile's Settings button and the HushThreads row in Threads' settings and opens every HushThreads settings page. A screen only counts when Threads shows that screen's own view, since a link Threads doesn't handle still opens Threads, on the feed. Any Threads crash or ANR since the walk began fails it, and the receipt it writes is the one publish asks for. Its only taps are those three steps and the settings rows, each checked on its own screen, so it can't follow, block or message anyone, or like a post.

## Update

1. You need [Morphe Manager](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager) 2.0.0 or newer. If HushThreads is already one of your patch sources, Manager shows 0.0.16 once it refreshes. If it isn't, add it: https://morphe.software/add-source?github=SysAdminDoc%2FHushThreads
2. Get Threads 452.0.0.50.64 (arm64-v8a, version code 512207626) and patch that. v0.0.15 was the last release for Threads 451.
3. Manager's default selection has every patch except `Change version code`, `Remove share targets` and `Trust user-added certificates`. Turn on Expert mode if you want any of those.
4. Patch with the Morphe Manager signing key you used last time. That's what lets the update install over your patched Threads and keep your data and your login. Coming from the stock Threads, uninstall it first.
5. On a fresh install, sign in with your Instagram username and password.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Threads APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushThreads#install).

## Validation

1004 runtime tests and 287 patch tests passed locally, along with both Android lints and the release script checks. All 20 patches applied without forcing to Threads 452.0.0.50.64, and the release receipt records the run. The dependency advisory check passed.
